description: ADR 30.9.26am D5: the manifest builder's refusals, held to one answer in seven kits. manifest is A1 §2's wire form; expect is {ok: true} or {refused: <rule>}. Rules, in order (a refusal names the first broken one): manifest_version — not the integer 1. default_locale — absent, not a non-empty string, or not a key of name or of description (when that is an object). name — not a non-empty object whose every value is a string of 1–40 Unicode scalar values after trimming Unicode White_Space, free of C0/C1 controls, bidi overrides U+202A–U+202E, isolates U+2066–U+2069 and zero-width U+200B–U+200F, U+FEFF (checked on the trimmed value). description — the same with 1–280. render_url — not a string that starts with https:// (scheme case-insensitive) followed by at least one character other than / ? #. slots — absent, not a non-empty list, or an element that is not an AppSlotName. context — present and not a list, or an element that is not a ContextSlice kind. duplicate — a repeated value in slots, context or scopes. too_large — the compact UTF-8 JSON of the seven stored keys (default_locale, name, description, slots, context, scopes, tutor_note; context and scopes default [], tutor_note false) over 65536 bytes. A kit cannot know A1's supported-locale list, the rest of the URL policy, DNS, or the client's allowed scopes; those stay the upload's refusals.
